summary: ING Groep NV filed a 6-K announcing partial reduction of its stake in TMBThanachart Bank (TTB) by participating in TTB's share buyback. ING's stake (excl. treasury shares) decreased from 23.1% to 19.5%. Gross proceeds to ING are approximately €243 million. The transaction reflects active capital management and portfolio optimization. ING remains a significant shareholder and values its partnership with TTB. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction is not expected to materially impact ING's profit, equity, or capital ratios. Watch for completion of TTB's buyback and any future stake reductions.
